changes: Readiness before audio mutations; real native AutoTune/queue locks inherited by recovery workers.
Controlled PCM with repeat-current; preserve playlist order, duplicates, flags and user configuration.
Capability-based physical ALSA USB, PCI/HDA, HDMI and platform targets; host fallback and portable CPU sensors.
USB without serial bound to the live connection and boot; non-USB avoids USB-only controls.
Native RT receiver path fix and exact token acknowledgment; USB protection remains enabled.
Uniform CPU sampling, exact scheduler observation window and bounded completion of already-open waits.
Validated per-CPU chronological merge with temporary indices; real clock regressions and event loss remain failures.
One logged pre-write baseline retry only for isolated CPU pressure, within the original deadline.
CPU-busy restored windows reject the comparison after verified recovery, without retry or promotion; zero complete comparisons remains inconclusive.
Crash-safe policy metadata recovery, conditional undo and per-cycle native locking.
Report-only probes removed from repeated scans; explicit inconclusive outcomes and actionable GUI explanations.
Byte-verified update installer with private backup, idempotent verification and rollback.

limits: Hardware portability fixtures do not certify every physical device or architecture.
The existing Daphile ISO is x86_64; this delivery does not create an ARM ISO.
Local PCM calibration does not qualify NAS playback, every rate/codec/DSD, bit-perfect output or analog sound quality.
No global optimum or audible improvement is claimed; deferred candidates remain explicit in the run.
The original 1800-second total budget includes the recovery reserve.
